name: custom
vibe: BitPlan document viewer. Quiet physical objects in a reading room. Every event is a different material and envelope.

item-hover.prompt: A near-silent brush of linen across paper. One tiny grain of friction, no pitch, no second note. Extremely short hover cue, about 80 milliseconds of air and fabric only.

nav-item-hover.prompt: A single dry tick of a fingernail on a wooden shelf edge. One instantaneous grain, slightly sharper than fabric, no melody, no second note. Very short navigation hover. Quiet, close, no reverb.

nav-tab-switch.prompt: A tiny lateral slide of one index card across another, left to right. Two dry paper layers rubbing, not a percussive hit. Short tab-change UI sound, under 300 milliseconds.

nav-back.prompt: A soft reverse page-turn. One leaf folding back toward the left with a slight downward puff of air. Dry paper only. Short back-navigation UI sound.

nav-forward.prompt: A soft forward page-turn. One leaf lifting to the right, a little brighter air than a back turn. Dry paper only. Short forward-navigation UI sound.

button-click-primary.prompt: Subtle, Quiet grandiose library interface. Watercolor paper grain, warm wood and ink. Subtle short clicks. Refined, calm, trustworthy. Not digital bleeps, not 8-bit, not arcade, not glassy sci-fi., main action tap click, short UI sound, minimal interface feedback

button-click-secondary.prompt: A light fingertip tap on thin cardstock. Higher and thinner than a desk knock, papery, one transient only, almost inaudible. Very short UI tap. Paper only.

button-click-destructive.prompt: A short firmer knock on thick bound leather. Still quiet, harder attack than a normal click, low and dry. Very short UI warning tap. Leather and wood only.

nav-menu-open.prompt: A quiet bloom of air as a heavy cloth-bound folio opens. Slow swell then settle. Felt and paper only, no musical notes, no metal. Short menu-open UI sound, under 400 milliseconds.

nav-menu-close.prompt: A single downward felt mute as that folio closes. One soft droplet of sound falling and stopping. No second hit, no latch click, no bell. Short menu-close UI sound.

notification-success.prompt: Three quiet felt-piano notes in a low-mid major third, each quieter than the last, landing on the tonic. Resolved cadence, warm hammers, piano body only. Short success confirmation, about 400 milliseconds.

notification-error.prompt: A dry knuckle knock on a table, then one descending muted gut-string scrape. Concern without panic. No buzzer, no siren, no rising whoop. Short recoverable error UI sound.

notification-warning.prompt: One held slightly sour woodwind interval, two close pitches that do not resolve. Mid-urgency, still quiet. No alarm klaxon, no repeating beep. Short warning UI tone, under 400 milliseconds.

notification-info.prompt: A single small glass-rim tick. One pitch only, no second note, no melody, cool and thin, almost no sustain. Short information notice.

notification-badge.prompt: The tiniest ceramic counter tap, like one bead touching a saucer once. Extremely short, no ring, no sustain, no melody.

toggle-on.prompt: A small metal latch engaging in two parts: a dull seat, then a brighter clack. Mechanical, short, close-mic. Switch turning on.

toggle-off.prompt: The same small metal latch releasing in two parts reversed: a bright unhook, then a dull rest, slightly lower than toggle on. Mechanical, short. No beep. Switch turning off.

checkbox-check.prompt: A graphite pencil making one dry tick-mark on an index card. Papery, close, no metal spring, no click-clack. Short checkbox select.

checkbox-uncheck.prompt: A soft rubber eraser lifting off paper. One reverse of a pencil tick, airy, no mechanical click. Short checkbox deselect.

loading-complete.prompt: A tiny dry focus tick, then a short harmonic bloom of warm air. Content is ready to use. Air and a single tick, not a cadence.

modal-open.prompt: Air filling a small felt-lined box as the lid lifts. Slow intimate bloom, close to the ear. Felt and air only. Short modal-open UI sound.

modal-close.prompt: A felt-lined lid settling shut. One downward muted thump, then silence. No latch rattle, no melody. Short modal-close UI sound.

dropdown-open.prompt: A small paper fan unfolding two folds. Dry, quick, slightly upward. Paper only. Short dropdown-expand UI sound.

dropdown-close.prompt: A paper fan folding once. Faster and drier than the open, slight downward motion. No click. Short dropdown-collapse UI sound.

tx-sent.prompt: A thick envelope sliding into a wooden mail slot. Paper on wood, one whoosh then a stop. Quiet work, not a celebration. Short transaction-sent UI sound.

tx-received.prompt: A held muted fifth on low strings that never resolves. Very quiet, waiting, no pulse, no arpeggio, no tick. Short pending-wait UI tone.

tx-confirmed.prompt: A sealed envelope landing on a desk. One soft slap of heavy paper, warmer and closer than a send. No melody. Short payment-received UI sound.
